svg.text: STEP/DIR/ENABLE: 3.3 V logic only. Limits: normally closed dry contacts to GND; open circuit is a fault.
TMP112 address 0x48; board temperature only. Firmware must enforce motor current and temperature limits.
J_MOTOR A1/A2 = one winding; B1/B2 = the other. Confirm cable colors against exact motor before use.
